environment.description: Same application deployed on a Kubernetes 1.29 cluster with Pod Security Admission enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. The pod securityContext specifies runAsNonRoot: true (uid 1654), readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. The container spec includes securityContext.capabilities.drop containing ALL with no capabilities added back. The node uses gVisor (runsc) as the container runtime via RuntimeClass 'gvisor', which intercepts all syscalls through its application kernel sentry. Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only port 443 toward the cluster's internal service mesh endpoints. The OCI runtime spec generated by containerd shows no ambient or bounding capabilities in the effective set.
